protocol.title: Membrane-less Microfiltration Using Inertial Microfluidics
protocol.platform: Multiplexed inertial microfluidics (spiral PDMS microchannels, trapezoidal cross-section, passive pressure-driven flow)
cell_lines: Saccharomyces cerevisiae (yeast, rehydrated dry strain, Sigma-Aldrich)
protocol.objective: Continuous, membrane-less, size-based cell filtration and fractionation at macroscopic flow rates (~500 mL/min); demonstrated for CHO perfusion bioreactor cell retention, yeast microfiltration, and CHO cell cycle synchronisation

device.fabrication: Soft lithography; master mold machined by precision micro-milling (Whits Technologies, Singapore) on aluminium; PDMS layers bonded by O2 plasma (Harrick Plasma, USA)
device.fluid_delivery: 3D-printed SLA guide layer with internal fluidic channels and conical pins; distributes flow equally across all microchannels

outlet_description.outer_outlet: Cell concentrate / recycle stream (filtration mode: all cells; fractionation mode: small G0/G1 cells)
outlet_description.inner_outlet: Clarified filtrate / product harvest (filtration mode: cell-free media; fractionation mode: large G2/M cells)

working_principle.inertial_lift_force: F_L proportional to a_p^4; shear-induced + wall-induced lift; drives particles to channel wall equilibrium positions
working_principle.dean_drag_force: F_D proportional to a_p^2; generated by two counter-rotating Dean vortices in curvilinear channel; Dean number is linear function of Re
working_principle.trapezoidal_advantage: Stronger Dean vortex cores near outer wall; traps smaller particles at outer wall; enhances separation throughput and efficiency vs rectangular cross-section
working_principle.filtration_mode: High flow rate (~6 mL/min per spiral): all cells focus near outer wall; exit outer outlet as concentrated fraction
working_principle.fractionation_mode: Low flow rate (~1.5-2 mL/min per spiral): small cells (G0/G1, <14 um) trapped near outer wall; large cells (G2/M, >14 um) focused near inner wall; size-based separation at two outlets
working_principle.separation_basis: Hydrodynamic forces only; no external force fields (passive system)

reagents.cell_suspension_buffer: BSA-EDTA Buffer: 1x PBS, 2 mM EDTA, 0.5% BSA (MiltenyiBiotec) — prevents agglomeration and wall adsorption
reagents.device_priming: PBS (1x phosphate buffered saline, 2 mM EDTA, 0.5% BSA)

cell_culture_media.hybridoma_AE1: Hybridoma-SFM (Gibco); 100 rpm magnetic stir; 37 C, 5% CO2
cell_culture_media.CHO_K1: Low-glucose DMEM (Invitrogen) + 10% FBS + 1% penicillin/streptomycin; 37 C, 5% CO2
cell_culture_media.MDA_MB_231: Low-glucose DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% pen/strep; 37 C, 5% CO2

viability_stains.trypan_blue: Exclusion dye; live/dead cell count prior to PI/FDA staining

reagents.IgG_ELISA: IgG1 ELISA kit (Abcam, Cat. ab100548); IgG1 protocol

cell_cycle_stain.hoechst: NucBlue LiveReadyProbes (Invitrogen); 10 ug/mL RNase (i-DNA Biotechnology); 3.8 mM sodium citrate in 1x PBS
cell_cycle_stain.readout: BD LSR II flow cytometer; FlowJo software

reagents.trypsin_EDTA: 0.01% trypsin + 5.3 mM EDTA (Lonza); used for CHO-K1 monolayer dissociation
reagents.conditioned_media: Complete DMEM for CHO recovery post-synchronisation

applications.name: CHO Cell Retention from Perfusion Bioreactor

steps.name: Device priming
steps.notes: Wets PDMS microchannels; eliminates air bubbles; BSA prevents non-specific cell adsorption to channel walls

steps.name: CHO cell suspension preparation
steps.notes: Separation efficiency >95% up to 1e7 cells/mL; declines above threshold (Fig. 2b)

steps.name: Inertial filtration — CHO cell separation
ir_operations: if choSignal1[0] > 0 | true: jump bsbbif_2_t | false: jump bsbbif_3_f
steps.operation: mix (abstracts pressure-driven inertial focusing through 8-loop spiral at 6 mL/min)

pass.action: dispense freshMedia; mix recycledCells; heat 37C 1440m; dispose

steps.name: Cell recycle and perfusion culture continuation
steps.notes: Daily microfiltration cycles over 10-day run; fresh media replenished each cycle; IgG titer and cell density monitored daily (Fig. 2c,d)

steps.name: Cell viability assessment — PI/FDA dual staining
ir_operations: if viabilitySignal1[0] > 0 | true: jump bsbbif_5_t | false: jump bsbbif_6_f
steps.c_FOS_shear_marker: No upregulation vs controls (culture media 37C and PBS 22C); residence time <0.1 s prevents AP-1 pathway activation

steps.name: IgG antibody titer ELISA
ir_operations: if titerSignal1[0] > 0 | true: jump bsbbif_8_t | false: jump bsbbif_9_f

steps.name: Yeast suspension preparation
steps.rehydration: Dry S. cerevisiae rehydrated at 35 C, 10 min; centrifuged 2000 g 15 min; washed twice with distilled water; pellet resuspended in BSA-EDTA running buffer
steps.notes: 1e5 cells/mL (0.05 g/L): >90% efficiency; 1 g/L: reasonable single-cycle performance (Fig. 3b)

steps.name: Inertial filtration — yeast separation
ir_operations: if yeastSignal1[0] > 0 | true: jump bsbbif_11_t | false: jump bsbbif_12_f
steps.operation: mix (abstracts inertial focusing through 30x70 um trapezoidal yeast spiral at 2 mL/min)
steps.benchmark: Outperforms cellulose acetate and Teflon membrane filters in long-term flux (Fig. 3c); membrane flux declines progressively due to fouling; inertial system maintains constant throughput

steps.name: Inertial fractionation — cell cycle sorting
steps.operation: mix (abstracts size-differential inertial focusing at low flow rate fractionation regime)
steps.notes: G0/G1 cells (<14 um) exit outer outlet; G2/M cells (>14 um) exit inner outlet; multiple rounds improve enrichment

steps.name: Hoechst DNA staining and FACS cell cycle analysis
ir_operations: if syncSignal1[0] > 0 | true: jump bsbbif_14_t | false: jump bsbbif_15_f

pass.action: dispense conditionedMedia2; mix synchronisedCells2; heat 37C 3600s; dispose

steps.name: Synchronised cell recovery for downstream use
downstream_applications: Anti-cancer drug screening (drugs target specific cell cycle phase)
Recombinant protein production (G1-phase CHO grows faster; higher yield)

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 16 basic blocks (BB1-BB16), 4 if/else gates, 20 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations converted to minutes (m) for compiler compatibility (BioScript supports s and m only; h token not supported)

duration_conversions.1440m_CHO_culture: 86400.0 SECOND in IR (1 day perfusion cycle)

abstraction_notes.mix: Abstracts pressure-driven inertial focusing through spiral microchannels; not DMF electrode mixing
abstraction_notes.drain_vs_dispose: Compiler treats drain and dispose equivalently in IR; distinction is source-level only
abstraction_notes.bsbbif_6_f_bsbbif_9_f_bsbbif_12_f_bsbbif: Compiler emits dispose in fail branches regardless of source drain keyword; verified correct in IR

bioscript_compiler_notes.platform_note: This protocol encodes passive inertial microfluidics (no DMF electrodes). mix abstractions reflect hydrodynamic channel flow events. Device operates at macroscopic flow rates unsuitable for droplet-digital microfluidic modelling.
